stem.text: The photomicrographs show cells in various stages of the cell cycle.
In which stage does semi-conservative replication of DNA take place?

A.alt: Photomicrograph of a cell containing dark thread-like structures in its centre.

B.alt: Photomicrograph of a cell with two groups of dark thread-like structures at opposite ends and a pale band between them.

C.alt: Photomicrograph of a cell containing a dense, round, granular mass.

D.alt: Photomicrograph of a cell containing many dark thread-like structures spread across its area.
